camel_example: aliyun cloudapi CreateApiGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName Weather --Tag.1.Key key --Description 'The_weather_informations.' --InstanceId 'apigateway-cn-v6419k43xxxxx' --Tag.1.Value value --BasePath '/qqq'
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi create-api-group --group-name Weather --base-path /qqq --description The_weather_informations. --instance-id apigateway-cn-v6419k43xxxxx --tag Value=value Key=key --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApiGroup

parameters.help_en: The group name. It must be unique and can contain only letters, digits, underscores, and Chinese characters. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. Its length must be 4 to 50 characters
parameters.help_zh: 分组名称，必须唯一，支持汉字、英文字母、数字、英文格式的下划线，必须以英文字母或汉字开头，4~50个字符
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The root path for APIs in this group
parameters.name: base_path

parameters.help_en: A description of the API group. It can be up to 180 characters long
parameters.help_zh: API分组描述，不超过180个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The object tags to which the rule applies. You can specify multiple tags
parameters.help_zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个
parameters.name: tag
